version.changelog:
- Added multilingual documentation: README files now available in Japanese (README.ja.md) and Chinese (README.zh.md), alongside English.
- No functional or workflow changes to core capabilities.

llm.summary: This skill provides web-accessibility and automation-readiness guidance with expected, disclosed code and spec-writing workflows.

dimensions.detail: Fetching URLs, reading selected files or representative project files, and editing web templates are proportionate to the skill's web-audit and rewrite purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is markdown-only with README installation guidance for placing SKILL.md and references together; no executable installer, dependency installation, or hidden setup behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Trigger examples include broad web-development phrases such as SEO and a11y audit, so users should invoke it intentionally, but the workflows remain scoped to web page analysis, template rewrites, and design specs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The design-spec workflow writes agent-friendly-spec.md in the workspace, but there is no cross-session persistence, service installation, memory modification, credential use, or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to analyze or rewrite web pages for semantic HTML, ARIA, structured data, stable selectors, and automation use; the referenced materials consistently support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an agent to audit or improve web pages for accessibility, structured data, scraping, and automation. Review proposed code edits before applying them, and ask it to show or confirm the spec file content before writing if you want tighter control.
llm.findings:
[OH1] expected: The flagged dangerouslySetInnerHTML example is used for JSON-LD structured data in framework guidance, a common implementation pattern for this purpose; users should still ensure inserted values are JSON-encoded and trusted.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger examples are real but aligned with the skill's SEO, accessibility, structured-data, and automation-selector scope; this is a usability/scoping note rather than evidence of hidden or unsafe behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Writing agent-friendly-spec.md is explicitly part of the design-spec workflow and is limited to a project documentation artifact, though users may prefer to ask for confirmation before saving.
[SQP-3] expected: The localized README files are documentation translations and do not impose unsafe runtime behavior or override user language preferences.
